def get_features(db, entity_ids, seed_time):
    seed_time = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)
    entity_ids = list(entity_ids)

    orders = db['orders']
    items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']

    feature_cols = [
        'order_count', 'total_items', 'total_price', 'avg_price',
        'total_freight', 'avg_freight', 'distinct_sellers', 'recency_days',
        'avg_review_score', 'review_count', 'total_payment', 'payment_count',
        'avg_installments',
        'order_count_last_30d', 'order_count_last_60d', 'order_count_last_90d',
        'total_price_last_30d', 'total_price_last_60d', 'total_price_last_90d',
        'sales_trend_30_90', 'days_since_first_sale', 'active_span_days',
        'price_std', 'freight_ratio', 'seller_orders_share',
        'avg_review_score_last_90d', 'review_neg_share', 'avg_installments_last_90d',
        'items_per_order', 'cancelled_share', 'delivered_share',
        'total_revenue_last_180d', 'order_count_last_180d',
        'review_count_last_90d', 'avg_pay_value'
    ]

    # ---------- Orders known at seed_time (purchases) ----------
    orders_before = orders[orders['order_purchase_timestamp'] < seed_time]

    # ---------- Reviews known at seed_time ----------
    # A review exists at seed_time only if it was already created (review_creation_date).
    if not reviews.empty and 'review_creation_date' in reviews.columns:
        rev_known = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] < seed_time]
    else:
        rev_known = reviews

    review_stats = rev_known.groupby('order_id').agg(
        avg_review_score=('review_score', 'mean'),
        review_count=('review_score', 'count'),
        review_min=('review_score', 'min')
    ).reset_index() if not rev_known.empty else pd.DataFrame(
        columns=['order_id', 'avg_review_score', 'review_count', 'review_min'])

    # ---------- Payments known at seed_time ----------
    # payments has ts = purchase time of the order; only use payments of past orders
    if not payments.empty and 'ts' in payments.columns:
        pay_known = payments[payments['ts'] < seed_time]
    else:
        pay_known = payments

    payment_stats = pay_known.groupby('order_id').agg(
        total_payment=('payment_value', 'sum'),
        payment_count=('payment_value', 'count'),
        avg_installments=('payment_installments', 'mean')
    ).reset_index() if not pay_known.empty else pd.DataFrame(
        columns=['order_id', 'total_payment', 'payment_count', 'avg_installments'])

    # ---------- Base: item positions of past orders ----------
    base = items.merge(
        orders_before[['order_id', 'order_purchase_timestamp',
                       'order_status', 'order_delivered_customer_date']],
        on='order_id', how='inner'
    )
    # drop items whose order isn't in orders_before (merge already handles that)

    if not base.empty:
        base = base.merge(review_stats, on='order_id', how='left')
        base = base.merge(payment_stats, on='order_id', how='left')
        base['is_cancelled'] = base['order_status'].isin(
            ['canceled', 'unavailable']).astype(float)
        base['is_delivered'] = (base['order_status'] == 'delivered').astype(float)

    if base.empty:
        features = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=entity_ids, columns=feature_cols)
        features['recency_days'] = 9999.0
        return features

    grouped = base.groupby('product_id')
    order_groups = base.groupby(['product_id', 'order_id'])

    features = pd.DataFrame({
        'order_count': grouped['order_id'].nunique(),
        'total_items': grouped.size(),
        'total_price': grouped['price'].sum(),
        'avg_price': grouped['price'].mean(),
        'total_freight': grouped['freight_value'].sum(),
        'avg_freight': grouped['freight_value'].mean(),
        'distinct_sellers': grouped['seller_id'].nunique(),
        'recency_days': (seed_time - grouped['order_purchase_timestamp'].max()).dt.days.astype(float),
        'avg_review_score': grouped['avg_review_score'].mean(),
        'review_count': grouped['review_count'].sum(),
        'total_payment': grouped['total_payment'].sum(),
        'payment_count': grouped['payment_count'].sum(),
        'avg_installments': grouped['avg_installments'].mean(),
        'cancelled_share': grouped['is_cancelled'].mean(),
        'delivered_share': grouped['is_delivered'].mean(),
        'price_std': grouped['price'].std(),
        'items_per_order': grouped['order_id'].count() / grouped['order_id'].nunique(),
    })

    # days since first sale / active span
    first_sale = grouped['order_purchase_timestamp'].min()
    features['days_since_first_sale'] = (seed_time - first_sale).dt.days.astype(float)
    features['active_span_days'] = (
        (grouped['order_purchase_timestamp'].max() - first_sale).dt.days.astype(float))

    # freight ratio
    features['freight_ratio'] = features['total_freight'] / features['total_price'].replace(0, np.nan)

    # seller concentration: share of items from top seller
    top_seller = base.groupby(['product_id', 'seller_id']).size().reset_index(name='n')
    top = top_seller.groupby('product_id')['n'].max()
    tot = top_seller.groupby('product_id')['n'].sum()
    features['seller_orders_share'] = (top / tot.replace(0, np.nan))

    # time-window features
    ts = base['order_purchase_timestamp']
    for window in [30, 60, 90, 180]:
        mask = (ts >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=window)) & (ts < seed_time)
        sub = base[mask]
        features[f'order_count_last_{window}d'] = sub.groupby('product_id').size()
        features[f'total_price_last_{window}d'] = sub.groupby('product_id')['price'].sum()
        features[f'total_revenue_last_{window}d'] = sub.groupby('product_id')['total_payment'].sum()

    # sales trend: last 30d vs previous 60d
    w30 = features.get('order_count_last_30d', pd.Series(0, index=features.index))
    w90 = features.get('order_count_last_90d', pd.Series(0, index=features.index))
    prev60 = (w90 - w30).astype(float)
    features['sales_trend_30_90'] = w30.astype(float) - prev60

    # review features in last 90 days
    ts90 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
    sub90 = base[(ts >= ts90) & (ts < seed_time)]
    features['avg_review_score_last_90d'] = sub90.groupby('product_id')['avg_review_score'].mean()
    features['review_count_last_90d'] = sub90.groupby('product_id')['review_count'].sum()
    if 'review_min' in base.columns:
        neg = (sub90['avg_review_score'] <= 2).astype(float)
        neg_g = pd.Series(neg.values, index=sub90['product_id'].values).groupby(level=0).mean()
        features['review_neg_share'] = neg_g
    features['avg_installments_last_90d'] = sub90.groupby('product_id')['avg_installments'].mean()

    features['avg_pay_value'] = features['total_payment'] / features['payment_count'].replace(0, np.nan)

    # keep only defined feature columns
    for c in feature_cols:
        if c not in features.columns:
            features[c] = 0.0
    features = features[feature_cols]

    features = features.fillna(0)
    features = features.reindex(entity_ids, fill_value=0)
    features.loc[features['order_count'] == 0, 'recency_days'] = 9999.0

    return features
